simple.meaning: something expanded , i.e. the warp in a loom (as stretched out to receive the woof)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מַסֶּכֶת (H4545) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.

simple.summary: מַסֶּכֶת (maççeketh) means something expanded , i.e. the warp in a loom (as stretched out to receive the woof) First listed occurrence: Judg 16 13.

definitions.short: something expanded , i.e. the warp in a loom (as stretched out to receive the woof)
definitions.full: H4545. masseketh [ מַסֶּ֫כֶת ] noun feminine web of unfinished stuff, on loom (see GFM PAOS, Oct. 1889, clxxvii ); — only absolute מַסָּ֑כֶת Judg 16:13-14 ,. — מְסֻכָה מָסָךְ, see סכך .
definitions.rootNote: from 5259 in the sense of spreading out;
